description: Composite group of four calculated polythermal (isoplethal) sections of the Fe-Mn-Al-C system, each with T (°C) on the y-axis (200-1600, ticks every 200) and a composition axis along the bottom with "Fe" printed at the origin. The first three panels, which the caption assigns to Fe-15Mn-xAl-yC with Al = 4%, 7% and 10%, have x = C (wt%) from 0 to 2.5 (ticks every 0.5). They show L, L+δ, δ, L+γ, γ+δ, γ, γ+κ, γ+M3C/γ+M7C3, γ+α+κ(+M23C6, M7C3), α+κ, B2+β+M23C6, B2+M7C3+M23C6 and related fields; the single-phase γ field dominates at low C and shrinks while B2+κ expands as Al increases. According to the caption, dash-dotted lines mark the κ-phase formation temperature and dashed lines the disorder-to-order transition temperature; such lines are visible mainly in the low-temperature, high-C part of each section. Small arrows in the second and fourth supplied panels point to specific alloy coordinates (values not printed). The fourth supplied panel is anomalous: its x-axis is Al (wt%) from 0 to 12 and its fields are γ, γ+δ, γ+κ, α+κ, B2+κ, γ+B2+κ, α+γ+κ+M7C3, i.e. a section versus Al rather than versus C, so it cannot be the caption's (d) Al = 10% panel.

subfigures.description: Polythermal section vs C (wt%) 0-2.5 at T = 200-1600 °C. Large central γ field, L and L+δ at the top, L+γ on the upper right, γ+δ at upper left, γ+M3C and γ+M,C,κ on the middle right, α+M7C3 and α+M7C3+κ lower right, and γ+α+M23C6, γ+δ(α), γ+α(δ)+M6C, B2+β+M23C6 and B2+M7C3+M23C6 at low C. Dashed and dash-dotted lines appear near 400 °C at low C and in the lower-right corner.

Polythermal section vs C (wt%) 0-2.5 for the higher-Al alloy. Retains L, L+δ, δ, L+γ, γ+δ and γ, but adds κ-bearing fields: γ+κ, γ+κ+M3C (upper right), γ+α+κ+M23C6 and γ+α+κ+M7C3 (mid diagram, arrow-labelled), α+κ+M7C3, γ+B2+κ, and low-temperature B2+β+M23C6, B2+β+M23C6+M7C3, B2+β+M7C3, B2+β+κ+M23C6. Several dash-dotted and dashed lines cross the lower half.

Polythermal section vs C (wt%) 0-2.5, highest Al shown. The single-phase γ field is much smaller (roughly 1000-1300 °C at 1-1.4 wt% C); the diagram is dominated by γ+δ at upper left, γ+κ at right, γ+α(δ)+κ and α(δ)+κ bands near 800 °C, and a large B2+κ field occupying the whole lower region below about 800 °C. A dash-dotted line rises from about 900 °C to about 1300 °C and a dashed line falls from about 800 °C to about 600 °C.

Section versus Al (wt%) 0-12 (ticks every 2) instead of versus C, T = 200-1600 °C. Fields labelled L, L+γ, L+δ, γ+δ, γ, γ+κ, γ+M3C, γ+κ+M23C6, γ+κ+B2, B2+κ, α+κ, α+γ+κ+M7C3, α+γ+M7C3, γ+α+M23C6, γ+B2+M23C6, α+M23C6+β, B2+M23C6+β and B2+β+κ, with arrows at several field boundaries. Its composition axis does not match the caption's description of panel (d) (Al = 10%), which should be plotted against C.

observations.observation: All four supplied panels share the same ordinate: T (°C) from 200 to 1600 with tick marks every 200 °C.
In the first three panels the abscissa is C (wt%) from 0 to 2.5 with ticks every 0.5, and the point of origin carries the label 'Fe'.
The fourth supplied panel has a different abscissa, Al (wt%) from 0 to 12 with ticks every 2, so it is a section versus Al and not versus C.
A large single-phase γ field occupies the central part of the first two panels, reaching up to about the 1400 °C level at low C in the first panel.

With increasing Al the γ field shrinks and κ- and B2-bearing fields grow: the third panel has no large single-phase γ region, showing γ+δ (upper left), γ+κ (right) and a B2+κ field filling the region below roughly 800 °C.
Low-C, low-temperature fields printed in the first panel include γ+α+M23C6, γ+δ(α), γ+α(δ)+M6C, B2+β+M23C6 and B2+M7C3+M23C6.
The second panel carries κ-containing field labels not present in the first, including γ+κ+M3C, γ+α+κ+M23C6, γ+α+κ+M7C3, α+κ+M7C3, γ+B2+κ, B2+β+M7C3 and B2+β+κ+M23C6.
Small arrows are drawn inside the second and fourth supplied panels pointing to particular field boundaries/compositions, but no numeric coordinates are printed at the arrow tips.
The caption labels the panels 'Fe-15Mn-xAl-yC alloys calculated from FactSage as a function of C for Mn = 15% and various Al contents, (a) Al = 4%, (b) Al = 7%, (d) Al = 10%'.
The caption states that the dash-dotted lines are the formation temperature of the κ phase and the dashed lines are the disorder-to-order transition temperature.

Dashed and dash-dotted lines are visible only in the low-temperature and high-C parts of the first panel and cross the lower halves of the remaining panels; the same line style carries no legend printed inside the panels.

The citing text states that FactSage was used to calculate polythermal sections of the quaternary Fe-Mn-Al-C system as a function of C up to 2.5% with a fixed Mn content of 15% and various Al contents.
The citing text describes a separate figure as sections versus Al for fixed C of 0.85% and Mn of 20%, which matches the axis style of the fourth supplied panel rather than the caption of this figure.

unreadable_items: Some phase-field labels in the first two panels are rendered with broken subscripts (e.g. 'γ+M,C,κ'), so the exact carbide designation (M3C vs M7C3) is only partially readable.
The numeric temperature/composition coordinates referenced by the small arrows in the second and fourth supplied panels are not printed and cannot be read.
Panel letters (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) are not visibly printed inside the supplied panels; the assignment of panels to caption letters relies on the caption and on the order of the images.
The fourth supplied panel cannot be reconciled with the caption's '(d) Al = 10%' entry, which should be plotted against C (wt%) but is plotted against Al (wt%).
